name: How to use Arduino UNO as a USB to TTL converter
snippet: To use an Arduino board as a TTL-USB converter. Reset the board by grounding the reset pin; just connect a wire from reset pin to ground. Connect the RX pin on the Arduino board to the RX, TX to TX and GND to GND of the module. Connect the board to a USB port; through a USB type A type B cable.

name: How can I fix an AVRdude not-in-sync error when programming
snippet: Later arduino boards are built to reset whenever a serial connection gets made, and programmatically by the bootloader. This blog article describes how it works, and even more interestingly, how to hack it onto earlier boards. It shouldn't be too hard to put it on a breadboard if you wanted to.

name: How to Use Arduino as USB to Serial Converter
snippet: If you want to do serial debugging for your PIC, ESP8266, Bluetooth module and a TTL-to-USB converter (pictured below) is nowhere in sight, you can simply use an Arduino USB serial converter! The Arduino UNO has its own FTDI chip whose function is to convert TTL signal levels to USB.
